## The problem, briefly

Most small businesses don't have a data problem so much as a time problem. The numbers are spread across bank statements, inboxes, a spreadsheet one person understands, and the owner's memory — and pulling them together is nobody's job. AI tools stall for the same reason: they're easy to try, and hard to fit into how the work actually gets done.
:::

::: {.section}
## What I do

::: {.cards}
::: {.card-plain}
### Analytics & data

Getting your numbers into one place, kept current automatically, and shown in a dashboard you own. We start wherever you are — including nothing written down yet.

Working through your actual week, one session at a time, to find where AI saves real effort — and where it shouldn't be trusted. Personal and professional.

## About me

I'm a data scientist with a Master of Data Science from UBC and five years spent producing reports and outcome data for an employment services program — for people who needed answers, not analysis. I work with small businesses and individuals who have useful information trapped somewhere inconvenient.
